description: Clear action items with owners, one decision, nested risk
transcript: Sarah: We need to migrate the database by end of month. Tom: I can lead that, I'll have a plan ready by Wednesday. Sarah: Great. We decided to use PostgreSQL instead of MySQL going forward. Tom: Agreed. One concern — we don't have a staging environment set up yet, that could block the migration.

description: Simple standup — action items only, no decisions, no risks
transcript: Manager: Quick standup. Alice what did you do yesterday? Alice: Finished the auth module. Manager: Good. Bob? Bob: Still working on the dashboard, should be done today. Manager: Ok. No blockers? Bob: Nope. Manager: Good, let's sync again tomorrow.

description: Critical general risk should be extracted with high severity
transcript: CEO: We're launching next Friday no matter what. Dev: We still have 3 bugs open. CEO: Ship with known bugs, we'll patch post-launch. Dev: That's risky — users might hit the payment bug, it could break transactions. CEO: Document it. Dev: Ok, I'll write up the known issues doc by Thursday.

description: Hypothetical statements should NOT become action items
transcript: Alice: We should probably refactor the database someday. Bob: That would be nice, but not urgent. Alice: Maybe we could look into it next quarter. Bob: Might be good, but let's focus on current sprint.

description: Disagreement without resolution should not produce a decision
transcript: Alice: Let's use React. Bob: I strongly disagree. Vue is more performant. Alice: Let's table this and decide next week.

description: Risk nested inside action item with high severity
transcript: PM: John, deploy the payment API by Friday. John: I'm worried about database migration — if it fails, payments will be down for hours. PM: That's critical. Make sure you have a rollback plan. John: Will do, I'll prepare rollback scripts by Thursday.

description: Risk nested inside decision with medium severity
transcript: CTO: We've decided to migrate from Heroku to AWS. Sarah: There's a risk of cost overrun — AWS can be unpredictable. CTO: True, but we'll monitor. Sarah: Also, team needs training on AWS services. CTO: We'll schedule training after migration.

description: General risk + action nested risk + decision nested risk simultaneously
transcript: CEO: Q3 launch is June 1st. General risk: Our SSL certificate expires May 28th, affects everything. Dev Lead: I'll handle the certificate renewal by May 25th — risk: the new cert might not be compatible with old clients. CTO: We've decided to use Kubernetes for scaling. Risk: team has no K8s experience. Everyone: Agreed on K8s. Dev Lead: I'll set up a training session.

description: Low severity risk should be extracted as low
transcript: Alice: We need to update the documentation. Bob: Minor risk — the wiki is outdated but still usable. Alice: Ok, not urgent. Bob: I'll update it sometime next month when I have free time.

description: Multiple people assigned to same action item
transcript: PM: The login page needs to be fixed. Alice and Bob, can you both work on this? Alice: I'll do frontend. Bob: I'll handle backend. PM: Great, due Friday.

description: Action item mentioned but owner unclear - should NOT extract
transcript: Alice: Someone needs to restart the server. Bob: Yeah, that should be done. Alice: Can someone do it today?

description: Weak commitment with vague due date - extract as risk not action
transcript: Boss: Finish the report ASAP, but definitely soon. Maybe by end of week. Employee: Ok, I'll try.

description: Same risk mentioned repeatedly should not duplicate
transcript: Alice: Risk 1 — database migration could fail. Bob: Yes, that's a big risk. Alice: Again, migration risk is critical. Carol: Let's document it once.

description: Risk mentioned with solution should still extract risk
transcript: PM: Risk — API might be rate-limited. Solution: Add caching. Dev: Good, I'll implement caching by Wednesday.

description: Transcript with anonymous speakers - extract risks and actions
transcript: Speaker 1: We need to deploy today. Speaker 2: I'll handle it. Speaker 1: Risk — server might crash.

description: Empty or whitespace-only transcript
Long transcript with many speakers and items
transcript: Sarah: Let's start. We have 5 things: 1) Database migration by Friday. Tom: I'll do it, but risk — we might lose data. Sarah: High severity. 2) API documentation by Thursday. Alice: I'll handle docs. 3) Security audit. Bob: I'll schedule it. Risk — auditor is booked for 2 weeks. Sarah: Medium risk. 4) Frontend redesign. Carol: I'll start wireframes. 5) Testing. Dave: I'll set up test suite. Risk — no staging environment. Sarah: Critical. Everyone: Got it.

description: Severity inferred correctly from urgency words without explicit 'high'
transcript: Dev: Blocking issue — the build is failing, nobody can merge. PM: That's critical, fix immediately. Dev: Also, minor concern — documentation is slightly outdated.

description: Decision made by group consensus with implied action item
transcript: Team: Let's all agree to use Python 3.12. Everyone: Yes, agreed. PM: Decision made — we upgrade by June 1st.

description: Due date implied but not explicitly stated
transcript: Boss: The client presentation is on Monday. We need slides. Employee: I'll prepare them before the presentation.

description: Risk that relates to both decision and action item
transcript: CTO: Decision — use microservices. Risk — network latency between services. Dev Lead: Action — implement retry logic. That same latency risk applies here too.

description: Transcript with non-standard speaker formatting
transcript: [10:15] Alice > We need to fix this. [10:16] Bob -> I'll do it. [10:17] Alice >> Risk: server might crash.

description: Commitment without standard keywords
transcript: Alice: The database needs optimizing. Bob: On it. Alice: Thanks. Bob: Done by EOD.

description: Speakers identified by numbers only
transcript: User1: Deploy the fix. User2: I'll do it. User1: Risk — might break auth. User2: Noted.

description: Speaker names with special characters
transcript: Dr. Smith: Update the API. Ms. Jones: I'll handle it. Dr. Smith: Risk — rate limiting. Mr. Chen: Noted.
